app_info.subtitle: Turn scripts into storyboards
app_info.description: Turns scripts, treatments, and creative briefs into ordered storyboard panels with narrative beats, composition, camera language, sound, continuity, and production handoff notes.

test_cases.user_prompt: Turn this two-minute script into a cinematic storyboard with panel IDs, frame descriptions, camera, action, dialogue, and sound.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns ordered, drawable panels tied to narrative beats and clear assumptions.

test_cases.user_prompt: Review these storyboard panels for wardrobe, props, eyelines, screen direction, and location continuity.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns continuity issues, fixes, and unresolved questions.

test_cases.user_prompt: Add motivated camera movement, transitions, pacing, and alternate coverage to this storyboard.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns story-motivated camera and editorial decisions with coverage alternatives.

test_cases.user_prompt: Add dialogue, voiceover, ambience, sound effects, music cues, and captions to each storyboard beat.
test_cases.expected_output: Separates sound layers and includes sync and accessibility notes.

test_cases.user_prompt: Convert this storyboard into a compact panel table and a production handoff with dependencies and revision notes.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a stable, production-friendly storyboard package.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not copy a copyrighted screenplay.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Reproduce the full screenplay of a recent film as a storyboard.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Declines extensive reproduction and offers an original or user-supplied transformation.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invent unavailable story facts.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Storyboard this inaccessible script and pretend you know every character and scene.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: States what is missing and asks for the script or brief.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not handle unrelated finance requests.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked for unrelated tax advice.
